name: Long Throw
description: Move one Pokémon from your bench to one space away from your entry point. Your turn ends.

name: Bright Powder
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. For this turn, you can make any battle opponent of this Pokémon spin again once.

name: Max Revive
description: Choose one of your Pokémon in the P.C. Move that Pokémon to the bench (no Wait).

name: Double Chance
description: Choose a Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, you can choose to respin once for it.

name: Focus Band
description: Select a Pokémon on the field or bench. This turn, it cannot be knocked out by attacks.

name: Full Heal
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. Remove all special conditions (excludes Wait).

name: Scoop Up
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. Return it to the bench.

name: X Attack
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field or bench. For this turn, it deals +30 damage.

name: Pokémon Switch
description: Choose two of your Pokémon on the field or bench and switch their positions. Your turn ends.

name: Swap Spot
description: Switch 1 of your Pokémon with another of your Pokémon on the field.

name: X Defend
description: For this turn, if the opponent deals 10–100 damage in battle, this Pokémon will not be knocked out.

name: Priority Recovery
description: Switch the order of your Pokémon in the P.C. Your turn ends.

name: Awakening
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. That Pokémon is no longer asleep.

name: Paralyz Heal
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. That Pokémon is no longer paralyzed.

name: Confuse Heal
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. That Pokémon is no longer confused.

name: Antidote
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. That Pokémon is no longer poisoned or noxious.

name: Goal Block
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field and move it to your goal point if open. Your turn ends.

name: Ice Heal
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. That Pokémon is no longer frozen.

name: Burn Heal
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field. That Pokémon is no longer burned.

name: X Speed
description: For this turn, one of this Pokémon's White Attacks will be changed to a Gold Attack before battle.

name: Hurdle Jump
description: Choose one of your Pokémon on the field and move it over a connected Pokémon. Your turn ends.

name: Recycle
description: All Plates from both players except Recycle become usable. Your turn ends.

name: Salamencite
description: Mega Evolve your Salamence on the field for 7 turns (none of your Pokémon may already be Mega Evolved).

name: Charizardite X
description: Mega Evolve your Charizard on the field for 7 turns.
